items.q: Are candles safe for babies to toddlers?
items.a: Absolutely, because we just use organic ingredients and does not use hazardous chemicals

items.q: After the smell runs out, will it pollute the environment?
items.a: No. Our soy wax and cotton wicks are biodegradable, and every jar can be cleaned and reused.

items.q: Are the materials used for the manufacture of chemicals?
items.a: We only use natural soy wax, essential oils and phthalate-free fragrance oils.

items.q: Can I resell wax products at a different price?
items.a: Yes, please contact us for our reseller program and wholesale pricing.
Orders are shipped within 1–2 business days and usually arrive in 2–5 days.
Shipping is free for every order over $100.
Unused candles can be returned within 14 days of delivery for a full refund.

items.q: How long does a refund take?
items.a: Refunds are processed within 3–5 business days after we receive your return.

description.title: Description
description.body: Hand-poured with natural soy wax and a cotton wick for a clean, even burn. Each candle burns for up to 45 hours and fills a medium room with a gentle, lasting scent.

ingredients.title: Ingredients
ingredients.body: 100% soy wax, essential oils, phthalate-free fragrance oil and a lead-free cotton wick. Vegan and cruelty-free.

howToUse.title: How To Use?
howToUse.body: On the first burn, let the wax melt to the edges (about 2 hours). Trim the wick to 5mm before each use and never leave a burning candle unattended.

howToFeel.title: How To Feel?
howToFeel.body: You are like being under a pine tree at the foot of the hill. The smell of earth mixed with rain will cool you
